text: Let $N$ be the number of positive integer divisors of $17017^{17}$ that leave a remainder of $5$ when divided by $12$. The number $17017$ appears on an old odometer, and a year has $12$ months. Find $N$.
A number theory club meets every $3$ days and has $25$ members. Let $N$ be the number of positive integer divisors of $17017^{17}$ that leave a remainder of $5$ when divided by $12$. Find $N$.

A warehouse holds $17017^{17}$ identical items, which must be packed into boxes that all contain the same number of items, with nothing left over. Let $N$ be the number of possible box sizes for which the number of items per box leaves a remainder of $5$ when divided by $12$. Find $N$.
check: box sizes are exactly the divisors; same count 26244

text: A marching band with $17017^{17}$ members lines up in rows of equal length with no one left over. Let $N$ be the number of possible row lengths that leave a remainder of $5$ when divided by $12$. Find $N$.
check: row lengths are exactly the divisors; same count 26244

text: Let $N$ be the number of positive divisors of $(7\cdot 11\cdot 13\cdot 17)^{17}$ that are congruent to $-7$ modulo $12$. Find $N$.
Let $N$ be the number of positive divisors $d$ of $17017^{17}$ such that $d \equiv 1 \pmod 4$ and $d \equiv 2 \pmod 3$. Find $N$.
check: by CRT, d = 5 mod 12 iff d = 1 mod 4 and d = 2 mod 3; brute force 26244
